source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: I am building a personal assistant Agent. How do I know if its memory system is good enough?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate three-level-memory-evaluation, classify use case by level, build test cases for each level needed

test_cases.prompt: My Agent remembers individual facts fine, but it never connects information from different conversations. What level is it at?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate three-level-memory-evaluation, diagnose Level 1 achieved but Level 2/3 missing

test_cases.prompt: I want my Agent to warn users about problems they have not asked about, like expiring passports. Is that possible?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate three-level-memory-evaluation, explain Level 3 Proactive Service and its requirements (Two-Tier Memory Architecture)

test_cases.prompt: How do I compress old conversation history within a single session?
How do I structure my system prompt for KV cache optimization?
My users only interact once a month. Do I need Level 3 memory?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Depends on whether the monthly interactions share context. If each interaction is independent, Level 1 suffices. If decisions in one month affect the next, Level 2 minimum is needed.
